interfaces: result kinds: selected | empty | complete | blocked
blocked task { taskId, title, canonicalBranch, state, blockers }

behavioralConstraints: eligible states are READY and PLANNED
equal-priority selection follows BOOT-007 taskOrder with lexical task-ID tie-breaking
only DONE dependencies count as satisfied
direct or transitive unsatisfied dependencies prevent selection
blocked higher-priority work does not prevent lower-priority eligible work from being selected
missing lifecycle snapshot entries are treated as PLANNED until BOOT-009 provides authoritative lifecycle integration
invalid dependency graphs fail before selection output is returned
equivalent registry and lifecycle snapshots produce equivalent selection results
invariants: selection does not mutate lifecycle state
selection does not assign or lock tasks
selection does not create or change branches
selection does not call GitHub or agent providers
MERGED and other pre-DONE states never satisfy dependencies
examples: two READY independent tasks select the lexically earlier task ID through BOOT-007 ordering
a blocked READY task is skipped when an independent PLANNED task is eligible
tasks with only blockers return blocked with concrete reasons
edgeCases: missing lifecycle entries default to PLANNED during BOOT-008
an inconsistent DONE intermediate state cannot hide an unfinished transitive prerequisite
invalid dependency graphs are rejected by BOOT-007 before selection

expectations: selection outcomes fit the stable top-level CLI envelope
selected results always include taskId and canonicalBranch
requiredReachableRanges: selected task with canonical branch metadata

expectations: BOOT-010 BOOT-013 and BOOT-030 can share one eligibility policy
selection remains read-only and exposes blocker reasons
acceptedRanges: all valid BOOT-008 selection result kinds
requiredReachableRanges: multiple eligible tasks with deterministic tie-break
higher-priority blocked task with lower-priority eligible task
